reconstruction.note: Only this procedure is checked: keep the sum of the products modulo d1*m (verified.check_modulus), divide by d1, then multiply by the inverse of d2 modulo m (verified.den_split). Keeping the sum modulo denominator*m and dividing by the whole denominator is a different procedure; it is not covered by this check and can fail on some residue pairs when d2 > 1.
